CVD = chemical vapor deposition; IPA = isopropyl alcohol 2.4.1 Technology Trends for Crystalline-Silicon Cells Prior to 2017–2018, the dominant cell architecture for multicrystalline and monocrystalline cells was commonly full-area aluminum back surface field cells, but the market switched to PERC by 2022 owing to its higher efficiency (Fischer et al. 2025). TOPCon, an even higher-efficiency cell architecture, captured most of the global market during 2022–2024 (Fischer et al. 2025). 19 This report is available at no cost from the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) at www.nlr.gov/publications. TOPCon most commonly uses n-type wafers and a higher-quality tunneling oxide layer on the bottom that is covered by a heavily doped polycrystalline silicon layer deposited by plasma- enhanced chemical vapor deposition or low-pressure chemical vapor deposition (Glunz et al. 2021). Typical commercial cell efficiencies jumped from 23% in 2022 to 25% in 2024 as the market switched from PERC to TOPCon (Fischer et al. 2025). While the steps for making TOPCon cells differ slightly, the process uses much of the same manufacturing equipment as PERC cell processing lines already in place. In addition to efficiency benefits, it is not uncommon to find TOPCon cells priced lower than PERC cells in 2025 (InfoLink Consulting Co. 2025), although our analysis indicates this is due to severe TOPCon cell overcapacity in China.
